description: Defines the SSLClientSessionCache class and related structures for managing SSL client session caching, including session lookup, insertion, expiration, and cache management functions.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache
classes.description: Manages SSL client session cache with configurable size and expiration policies, supporting lookup, insertion, and cache management.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the session cache, including maximum entries and expiration check frequency.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Key
classes.description: Unique key identifying SSL sessions, including server address, optional IP address, network key, privacy mode, and legacy crypto flag.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Entry
classes.description: Internal structure holding up to two SSL sessions for cache entries.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with specified configuration.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Static method to determine if an SSL session has expired based on current time.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a session associated with a cache key, moving it to the MRU position.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a session into the cache under a specific key, checking for stale entries periodically.

methods.name: ClearEarlyData
methods.description: Clears early data support for sessions associated with a cache key.

methods.name: FlushForServer
methods.description: Removes all cache entries for a specific server.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Removes all entries from the cache.

methods.name: SetClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom clock for testing purposes.
